questions.q: A combined oral contraceptive prevents pregnancy primarily through which endocrine mechanism?
options: Negative feedback suppression of pituitary FSH and LH, preventing follicular maturation and the LH surge
Stimulation of a premature LH surge
questions.explain: Oestrogen and progestin provide negative feedback on the hypothalamic-pituitary axis, suppressing FSH and LH and preventing the mid-cycle LH surge and ovulation. Progestin also thickens cervical mucus and alters the endometrium.

questions.q: Which mechanism is most important for the contraceptive action of a copper intrauterine device?
options: A local inflammatory reaction that impairs sperm function and fertilisation
Complete inhibition of ovarian oestrogen production
questions.explain: Copper ions and the local sterile inflammatory response in the uterine environment impair sperm motility, viability and fertilising capacity. A copper IUD is non-hormonal and does not primarily work by suppressing ovulation.
